source: differential, re-fitted with the length bits excluded 2026-09-08
note: The inherited fit carried base -1536 and three extra carriers [[7,7,768],[8,0,768],[13,7,-32768]]. Flipped ALONE on Apple's own instance 1700030001061084810000000003, byte7[7] re-lengths the instruction to 8 bytes and byte8[0] to 10; the decoder then prints operand 7 as 32, and the differential fit read that difference as a coefficient of 768. They are instruction-length bits, not displacement carriers. Only byte13[7] is a carrier: flipped alone the length stays 14 and operand 7 reads -31968 = 800 - 32768, so it is the sign bit. With base 0, these 15 positions and that one sign bit, all 32768 values round-trip exactly as op17193 length 14 through Apple's decoder. Evidence: tools/g17storeprobe.py --check.
